name: git
description: Perform git operations on a local repository. Supports status, diff, log, add, commit, push, pull, branch, etc.

manual.overview: Use git for version control operations. Check status, view diffs, commit changes, manage branches. Always check status before committing. Never force-push without explicit permission.

input.command: add -A && git commit -m "fix: resolve login bug"

examples.description: Create and switch to a new branch

tips: Always run 'status' and 'diff' before committing to review changes.
Write meaningful commit messages that explain WHY, not just WHAT.
Never commit secrets (.env files, API keys, credentials).
edge_cases: Force push and hard reset are blocked for safety.
Merge conflicts require manual resolution — read the conflict markers.
Large binary files should use Git LFS, not regular git add.
